findings: Nine message/node model files whole-read and Gitblobverified. Message contains timestamp, certificate,Objectcontent; no explicit message schema/algorithm recipe field. CollectionRepertoire wraps existing Collection model, adding no fingerprint compatibility contract.
MessageFactory assigns current epochmilliseconds and local certificate reference, not a defensive copy. No serialized snapshot or immutability established.

Node.equals/hashCode include id,name,nodeType,host,createdAt; name/host have generated setters, so hashCode changes after edits. Identity comparisons are not ID-only. Actual HashSet/Map usage and mutation behavior not runtime tested.
Node.active/online comments claim nonpersistent/local, but Transient annotations commented out; source mapping leaves fields persistent/serializable. Actual Hibernate/JAXB behavior not run.
Node.nodeType uses Enumerated without explicitSTRING; persistence ordinal coupling follows annotation default, but schema migration not qualified.
LocalNode fixes ID0 and cascades node; getters/setters and mutable lists permit shared state. No defensive concurrency snapshot in these models.

AddressListMessage and CollectionRepertoire rely on NonNull list annotation without length/cardinality/recipe limits. Message XmlSeeAlso lists CertificateRequest/CollectionRepertoire/Date but notAddressListMessage; actual JAXBcontext registration remains to inspect before asserting serialization failure.
